passages.quote:
This document is for businesses that use labour providers to supply people for work in the following sectors:

agriculture

horticulture

shellfish gathering

food processing and packaging

These labour providers will most likely need a Fair Work Agency gangmaster’s licence.

This guidance explains what happens when a labour user is inspected as part of the licensing process.
